text: The Terms of Reference for the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board state that the Board will hold up to four meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chair on delegation of the Chair. City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, approved the 2025 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance. The Chair has scheduled the following meetings for 2025: Date: Thursday February 6, 2025 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Date: Tuesday May 20, 2025 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1, City Hall/Video Conference Date: Monday September 15, 2025 Time: 9:30 a.m. Location: Committee Room…
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
